messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx spike detected on api-gateway (route=/v1/generate). 5xx rate = 12% over the last 5m, baseline 0.8%. Affected region: us-west-2. Sample corrid: corrid=ab12f9e4. Pager escalated.
alex: Acknowledged. I'm on call, jumping in. Sending initial triage ping to runtime and infra. Paging @marta @sanjay :phone:
marta: On it. Can we get a short timeline + sample corrids and a link to the KV-log bundle? Need traces for seq=1..5.
sanjay: Pulling KV logs now — sending a small sample here. Looks like repeated upstream 502s followed by gateway 504s.

sanjay: ```
# kvlog sample (truncated)
2026-03-17T15:02:11Z corrid=ab12f9e4 route=/v1/generate upstream=ai-runtime-1 status=502 retries=1
2026-03-17T15:02:12Z corrid=ab12f9e4 route=/v1/generate upstream=ai-runtime-2 status=502 retries=2
2026-03-17T15:02:13Z corrid=cd34a0b1 route=/v1/generate upstream=ai-runtime-1 status=504 retries=3
2026-03-17T15:02:13Z corrid=ef56b2c3 route=/v1/generate gateway=proxy-1 status=504 queue_ms=1200
```

marta: Noting that retries field is non-zero on the upstream lines. Hypothesis 1: client or proxy retries + upstream transient errors -> retry amplification -> gateway queueing -> 504s. Hypothesis 2: a hot shard on ai-runtime-1 returning 502s causing cascading retries.
runtime-ops: Agree with retry amplification as plausible. Also seeing elevated CPU on ai-runtime-1 and a backlog of pending requests in the runtime pool.
laurel: Customer impact — internal monitoring shows 3% of active users saw failed generation calls (couple of high-volume enterprise customers). Need estimated window and mitigation steps in-thread.

alex: Mitigation options:
- short-term: disable gateway retry handling for route /v1/generate (force pass-through of upstream status),
- mid-term: scale ai-runtime pool in us-west-2 (add 2 nodes),
- immediate: enable route fallback to smaller model to reduce load.
Which do we want to try first?

marta: Recommend immediate: disable gateway retry layer, scale pool + enable fallback. Disabling retries should cut amplification quickly. I'll prepare the rollback plan.

sanjay: Commands to gather full trace bundle for corrid=ab12f9e4:
```
# get traces
kubectl logs -l app=ai-runtime -c runtime --since=10m | grep ab12f9e4 > /tmp/trace-ab12f9e4.log
# fetch gateway kv logs
curl -s "https://log-collect/redwood/kv?corrid=ab12f9e4" -o /tmp/kv-ab12f9e4.json
```

pagerduty: Handoff: oncall alex -> marta in 30m. Severity: Sev2. Notify support to prepare incident update for impacted customers. :bell:
alex: Applying immediate mitigation: disabling gateway retry policy for /v1/generate in us-west-2 now. Pushing config.

alex: ```
# config update (preview)
route: /v1/generate
retry_policy: disabled
region: us-west-2
```

incidents-bot: Config change deployed to gateway-proxy-1, gateway-proxy-2 (rolling). Observability: please wait 60s for metric alignment.

marta: Scaling ai-runtime pool +2 in us-west-2 via autoscaling override now.
runtime-ops: Scaling action in progress — new nodes booting, warming caches.

laurel: Updated customer impact window estimate: start=2026-03-17T15:01Z end=ongoing (mitigations applied). We'll update once error rate drops below 1%.

sanjay: Early signal: 5xx rate down to 5% after disabling retries, but latency still elevated on gateway traces (queue_ms ~ 400-800ms). Some corrids still show multiple upstream attempts.

marta: Good. Continue to collect full trace bundles for the top corrids: ab12f9e4, cd34a0b1, ef56b2c3. Put in the shared incident S3 with key: s3://redwood-incidents/3842109876/traces/

alex: Confirmed runtime pool scaled. New capacity reducing pending queue. I re-enabled fallback route to smaller-model-v1 for long requests to relieve pressure.

runtime-ops: Observability note — we see one runtime instance with OOM garbage collection spikes coincident with the timeframe for corrid cd34a0b1. That node was rebalanced.

laurel: Preparing a short customer-facing blurb: "We're investigating elevated errors and timeouts affecting some generation requests in us-west-2. Mitigations applied, and we're monitoring recovery. We'll follow up with a post-incident report." Sending to support for approval.

sanjay: Attaching a compact timeline for the thread:
- 15:01:10Z first anomaly (503 bursts)
- 15:01:50Z pager triggered (5xx > 10% over 5m)
- 15:02:10Z repeated upstream 502s observed (corrid ab12f9e4)
- 15:02:30Z config: disabled gateway retries (mitigation 1)
- 15:03:00Z scale +2 runtime nodes (mitigation 2)
- 15:05:00Z errors down to ~3-5%, latency improving

marta: Next steps for RCA in-thread: collect full KV/log bundles, top-corrid trace assembly, check client-side retry behavior for enterprise tenants, and review runtime GC/CPU events on the implicated node. Assign owners: logs=sanjay, traces=alex, clients=laurel, runtime-heap=runtime-ops.

pagerduty: Acknowledged handoff. If error rate stays >2% after 30m, escalate to Sev1 and call a bridge.

alex: Quick note — sample client retry policy from tenant X shows aggressive 3 retries with no exponential backoff. If we confirm tenant-driven retries, we'll coordinate with account team for an applier fix.
marta: Thanks. Uploading collected artifacts now and starting the stitched timeline. Will draft RCA skeleton once trace assembly completes.

incidents-bot: Incident status: mitigations applied. Current error rate: 2.1% (down from 12%). Keep updates in thread. :white_check_mark:
